podcast.title: "Turn Blue" Album Announcement
podcast.body: The release of The Black Keys' *Turn Blue* album was notably announced by boxer Mike Tyson via a tweet, adding an unconventional and high-profile element to its promotion. "Its existence was announced by Mike Tyson, yes, him in a tweet."
